events.title: Demo Improvements & Balance Adjustments

events.title: KON-PON Demo Update – Improved Controls
events.summary: Update NotesKey Configuration Added: Customize your keyboard controls.Bomb Input Fix: Improved bomb input handling while using the CHARGE button.Menu Controls Improved: Optimized button assignments across various menus.Thank you for playing KON-PON SHMUP: Shapeshifter Showdown!We hope you enjoy the improved gameplay experience.

events.title: Notice of Major Demo Update

Its biggest feature is not just defeating enemies, but constructing your battle strategy while comparing enemy enhancements with your own item setup."ENEMY ATTACK SELECT" Changes the BattleBefore combat, the "ENEMY ATTACK SELECT" is performed with a slot machine-like effect, applying various negative factors to enemies. events.title: I updated the opening movie.
events.summary: We improved the content of the opening movie included in the DEMO version, so we've uploaded it to the store page.

events.title: We've released a new main visual
events.summary: We've updated the main visual on the Steam store page for 'KON-PON SHMUP'! This time, we focused on the protagonist, Sodeko, holding her sword, creating a visual that really conveys the feel of fighting through bullet hell.We'll continue developing the game toward the full release. Thanks for your support and for adding us to your wishlist!

events.title: New Boss Battle Trailer is Now Live!
events.summary: We've released a new boss battle PV!We've put together about 40 seconds of PV featuring intense battles with the unique bosses that appear in "KON-PON SHMUP -Shapeshifter Showdown-.Check out the fights against bosses that unleash bullet patterns, lasers, and powerful attacks!You can add it to your wishlist on Steam now.We appreciate your support!
